citations.title: Intro to GraphQL | Kojo API
excerpts: Intro to GraphQL GraphQL is a query language for APIs. Unlike REST, GraphQL allows you to define the structure of the data you receive. How do I use Kojo's GraphQL API? ​ First, you'll need to sign up for Kojo's developer program and [get your API key](https://docs.kojo.tech/docs/) . Once you've done this, you can begin querying the API. Let's get some information on an order: ``` $ curl \ -X POST \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <KOJO_API_KEY>" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.kojo.tech/graphql \ ``` ... GraphQL requests come in two forms: queries and mutations. Queries retrieve data from the Kojo API (like a REST "GET"). Mutations are used to modify data

basis.reasoning: Kojo provides a public API documentation portal and multiple substantive articles, including GraphQL and pagination documentation.
